hypothesis: Fault-local ETAS-normalized time since a magnitude-marked independent root contains renewal information absent from memoryless ETAS background.

state_contract.state: expected cumulative ETAS reset hazard since the last probabilistic marked reset
state_contract.daily_aging: analytical ETAS direct-background section mass times expected reset mark under Gutenberg-Richter
state_contract.daily_reset: one minus exp of negative posterior root mass times observed magnitude reset mark
state_contract.hazard_transform: positive log Brownian-passage-time hazard above unit-rate exponential baseline

warmup_contract.fault_source_availability: UCERF3 is treated as available on 2014-01-07; mapping then-known historical events to that source is allowed only to initialize forecasts issued on or after that date.
warmup_contract.limitation: The seven-year warmup is not a complete earthquake-cycle history.

fit_contract.selection: risk-sensitive annual IGPE with nonnegative low-ETAS veto
